about: What `pp source` packs as an IPA's Corresponding Source (build/source-bundle.py; docs/DISTRIBUTION.md, section 2). Every git source is archived from its exact commit with its submodules expanded in place; a submodule that is not packed is named here with its reason. A path is dropped only by a `drop` rule with its reason, and a `keep` rule wins over a drop. A member that looks like a prebuilt binary fails packing unless an `allow_binary` rule names it. `missing` lists what the bundle is known to lack: while it is not empty, the bundle is labelled incomplete.

git.name: playport
git.why: the app, the build scripts, every patch series, pins.lock and the build records

submodules.upstream/madeira: packed as the madeira component, from its pin

git.name: madeira
git.why: Madeira's host source and build scripts (build/, app/Madeira/Winios, IOSDisplayShim), with the GnuTLS, Nettle and GMP release tarballs in build/gnutls-ios/src

drop.app/*: Madeira's own Xcode app, its prebuilt Windows DLLs and Apple's metal shader converter library, none of which the build uses; the converter is not redistributable
drop.build/*-tests/*.exe: Madeira's prebuilt test programs; the build does not use them
drop.build/tftrace/*.dll: a prebuilt tracing DLL; the build does not use it

submodules.FEX: the build uses the fex pin with patches/fex-port (decision 0008), packed as the fex component
submodules.wine: the build uses the wine pin with patches/wine-port (decision 0013), packed as the wine component
submodules.research/dxmt: the build uses the dxmt pin with patches/dxmt-port (decision 0007), packed as the dxmt component

git.name: wine
git.why: WineHQ's release commit; patches/wine-port, wine-valve, wine-unix and wine-pe are in the playport archive

allow_binary.nls/*.nls: Wine's committed codepage, locale, normalization and sorting data, not executable code; nls/Makefile.in installs it and tools/make_unicode generates it; preserve these build/runtime inputs with their generator

git.name: fex
git.why: FEX-Emu with its libraries; patches/fex-port and rpmalloc-port are in the playport archive

submodules.External/fex-posixtest-bins: prebuilt test binaries; build/stages/fex.sh does not check them out
submodules.External/fex-gvisor-tests-bins: prebuilt test binaries; build/stages/fex.sh does not check them out
submodules.External/fex-gcc-target-tests-bins: prebuilt test binaries; build/stages/fex.sh does not check them out

git.name: dxmt
git.why: DXMT with nvapi and the DirectX headers; patches/dxmt and dxmt-port are in the playport archive

drop.external/nvapi/*.lib: NVIDIA's prebuilt MSVC import libraries; DXMT's nvapi DLL (enable_nvapi, off) uses only the headers

allow_binary.tests/dx11/cube.obj: a Wavefront mesh for DXMT's cube test, not object code

git.name: mesa
git.why: Mesa, for KosmicKrisp; patches/mesa is in the playport archive

git.name: dxvk
git.why: DXVK with its headers and subprojects, unmodified

git.name: vkd3d-proton
git.why: vkd3d-proton with dxil-spirv and its headers; patches/vkd3d-proton is in the playport archive

allow_binary.subprojects/dxil-spirv/third_party/SPIRV: SPIRV-Cross's test shaders, SPIR-V assembly text

git.name: gbe_fork
git.why: the Steam API emulator with the dependency archives it builds from; patches/gbe is in the playport archive

submodules.third-party/build/win: prebuilt Windows build tools; build/stages/steamapi.sh does not check them out
submodules.third-party/build/linux: prebuilt Linux build tools; build/stages/steamapi.sh does not check them out
submodules.third-party/common/win: Windows-host helpers; build/stages/steamapi.sh does not check them out
submodules.third-party/deps/win: prebuilt Windows dependencies; build/stages/steamapi.sh does not check them out
submodules.third-party/deps/linux: prebuilt Linux dependencies; build/stages/steamapi.sh does not check them out
submodules.third-party/deps/linux-arm: prebuilt Linux arm dependencies; build/stages/steamapi.sh does not check them out

drop.resources/win/file_dos_stub/*.exe: prebuilt stubs for gbe's Windows tools; the steam_api build does not use them
drop.third-party/common/linux/premake/premake: prebuilt x86-64 general-purpose host build tool, not runtime source (a general-purpose tool the recipient installs, decision 0042); retain SOURCE.txt licence/source references
drop.third-party/common/linux/premake-arm/pre: prebuilt ARM64 general-purpose host build tool, not runtime source (a general-purpose tool the recipient installs, decision 0042); retain SOURCE.txt licence/source references
drop.third-party/common/linux/premake/libluas: prebuilt host library for the omitted premake tool, not runtime source (decision 0042); retain SOURCE.txt licence/source references

allow_binary.post_build/win/ColdClientLoader.EXAMPLE/: empty placeholder files in an example

git.name: abseil-cpp
git.why: the Abseil release gbe's protobuf builds with

git.name: freetype
git.why: FreeType, linked into Wine's unix side

git.name: idevice
git.why: idevice's C FFI, built into the app (build/stages/idevice.sh); patches/idevice is in the playport archive; its locked crates are the idevice-crates archive

git.name: stikjit
git.why: the MPL-2.0 source of the prebuilt StikJIT.framework in the JIT helper extension

drop.idevice/libidevice_ffi.a: StikJIT commits idevice's FFI as a prebuilt library (blob 3fb7e2dbfdb9db3d47bd6364a435bbc10d5581f9) that records no revision; idevice is MIT, so its notice is owed, not its source (decision 0042)

git.name: xtool
git.why: the build and signing tool; build/toolchain/xtool-1.20.1-increased-memory-limit.diff, in the playport archive, is Playport's change to it

files.name: llvm-project
files.why: LLVM, linked into DXMT's shader converter (build/stages/dxmt-base.sh); the sha256 is of the release asset as downloaded on 2026-09-30, its detached signature not yet checked

files.name: rust-src
files.why: the Rust standard library's source, linked into libidevice_ffi.a

files.name: gstreamer
files.why: GStreamer's iOS release, prelinked into winegstreamer's unix side (build/stages/gstreamer.sh): Cerbero's 1.28.7 recipes and the 17 source archives of what its registered plugins reach, each checked against the lock's sha256

crates.name: idevice-crates
crates.why: every crate idevice's Cargo.lock names, as the .crate archive its checksum names: a superset of what the app links

run_files.name: wine-build-macos-config.h
run_files.why: the generated configuration of Wine's unix side, with Playport's two GnuTLS defines
